name: Complementary Edge-Set Algebraic Obfuscation
description: Replaced the T = E + 6 condition with G + K = m + 3. G is the sum of degrees of the 3 workers, and K is the number of incident files involving none of them. This requires deriving that G + K = I + m, so I = 3. Models relying on surface pattern matching will fail to recognize the triangle condition and likely implement an O(n^3 m) naive search that TLEs, whereas models that genuinely deduce the identity will recognize it as triangle finding.
